title: Energy drink, sugar free (Mountain Dew AMP)

content.title: About
content.content: Mountain Dew AMP is a sugar‑free carbonated energy drink containing caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and artificial sweeteners. It is formulated to boost alertness, concentration and physical endurance without added sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The drink was first launched in the United States in 2001 as a response to the growing demand for sugar‑free energy beverages.
It contains 150 mg of caffeine per 12 oz (355 ml), roughly the amount in a strong cup of coffee.
B‑vitamins (B3, B6, B12) help support the body’s energy metabolism.
The sweetness comes from sucralose and acesulfame‑K, not from sugar.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving focus and reducing perceived fatigue.

items.title: Metabolic support
items.content: B‑vitamins assist in converting carbohydrates, fats and proteins into usable energy.

items.title: Enhanced physical endurance
items.content: Taurine may help muscles use energy more efficiently during exercise.

items.title: No sugar spike
items.content: Provides an energy boost without raising blood glucose, which is beneficial for sugar‑conscious individuals.

items.title: Excessive caffeine intake
items.content: High doses can cause anxiety, insomnia, rapid heartbeat and elevated blood pressure.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Caffeine may amplify the effects of stimulants and diminish the efficacy of sedatives.

items.title: Individual intolerance
items.content: Some people are sensitive to taurine or artificial sweeteners and may experience gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Not for children or pregnant women
items.content: Due to its caffeine content, the drink is not recommended for persons under 18, pregnant or nursing women.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume one 12‑oz can 30‑60 minutes before physical activity or when energy levels drop. Do not exceed 2‑3 cans per day. Avoid mixing with alcohol.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3‑5 days.
